annotation_rule: Inspect RGB and 2D boxes only. Mark cup/mug on paired desk true, clearly on another surface false, uncertain null. Save labels before depth or 3D reference inspection.
support_proposal: Unchanged cup/mug footpoint inside surface box and median-depth gap <=0.75m.
primary_metric: Paired mean child 3D centroid error in metres, radial minus exact contact, on visually positive pairs using oracle 2D boxes and relations
secondary_metrics: pair detection and support proposal coverage
claim_limits: Seven spaced training-split desk candidates, one visual annotator, official intrinsics and manual 0.4m offset. No tuning on this sample. This transfers the already frozen table-development radial method; small n cannot establish broad novelty.
